results.title: A genuinely extractable PDF declared honestly
results.evidence: a text-bearing PDF filed under its true media type is counted unread and stays unread: `text_indexed` is written once in `attach()` as `media_type in TEXT_MEDIA` and no route in the API writes it again — there is no re-index, no extract, no correction.
